name: nomaerooms
description: NomaeROOMS — a multiplayer Backrooms browser game. Get lost with friends. Watch out for Pirate Clark.

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let h=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8'); h=h.replace(/<script type=\"module\" crossorigin src=\"\.\/assets\/index\.js\"><\/script>/, '<script src=\"./assets/index.js\"><\/script>'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html', h); console.log('Fixed script tag')"
